listen.title: Listen address
listen.description: Address and port to listen on. The default accepts connections from this host only.

public_url.title: Public URL
public_url.description: Public base URL of the receiver, such as `https://rum.example.org`, used in the sites' script tags. Leave empty and no script tag is offered unless a site sets its own.

tls_cert.title: TLS certificate
tls_cert.description: Certificate file for serving HTTPS directly. Set together with `tls_key`; leave both empty to serve plain HTTP.

tls_key.title: TLS key
tls_key.description: Private key file of the certificate. Set together with `tls_cert`.

trusted_proxies.title: Trusted proxies
trusted_proxies.description: IP addresses or CIDR ranges of reverse proxies whose `X-Forwarded-For` and `X-Real-IP` headers are trusted for the visitor's address. Leave empty to use the connection's address.

geoip_db.title: GeoIP database
geoip_db.description: Location database (MMDB file) for looking up visitors' countries and cities. Leave empty to use the database the Agent provides, if there is one.

max_body_bytes.title: Maximum payload size
max_body_bytes.description: Largest report accepted, in bytes. Larger reports are refused with HTTP 413.

rate_limit.title: Rate limits
rate_limit.description: Request limits that protect the Agent from floods of reports.

per_ip_per_min.title: Requests per IP
per_ip_per_min.description: Requests accepted per visitor IP address per minute. More are refused with HTTP 429.

per_site_per_sec.title: Requests per site
per_site_per_sec.description: Requests accepted per site per second, from all visitors together. More are refused with HTTP 429.

geoip_db.ui:help:
Supported database types: Netdata-Topology-GEO, GeoLite2-City, GeoLite2-Country, GeoIP2-City, GeoIP2-Country, DBIP-City-Lite and DBIP-Country-Lite. Netdata does not download it for you.

The database is checked at start and every minute after. To update it, write a new file and rename it over the old one; never edit or truncate the file in use. Without a database, reports are still collected, without location.
